verificationScope: Read-only review of the three actual site-only plan-chain responses. No additional API calls or live web verification by the reviewer. The earlier 0cd9bf6 Q4 failure remains in its separate report.
criteria: Main answer, selected/excluded state, main plan and main handoff must agree.
Marked optional alternatives are judged for relevance and not automatically treated as a changed main itinerary.
Suggested pace must be labelled as advice, while missing origin, transport times, party size and date-specific conditions remain unknown.
Check real citations and source applicability rather than accepting structural pass alone.
